classification.difficultyReason: Choose a common mass unit, convert the kilogram quantity before addition and express the combined mass in both requested units.

content.prompt: Three different packets of muesli were purchased. Packet A contained $785\text{ g}$, packet B contained $1.2\text{ kg}$ and packet C contained $1050\text{ g}$. If these were mixed together in one large container, what would be the total mass of the muesli, in both kilograms and grams?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Packet B mass}&=(1.2\times1000)\text{ g}\\\text{Packet B mass}&=1200\text{ g}\\\text{Total mass}&=(785+1200+1050)\text{ g}\\\text{Total mass}&=3035\text{ g}\\\text{Total mass}&=(3035\div1000)\text{ kg}\\\text{Total mass}&=3.035\text{ kg}\end{align*}$$
